title: The Broughton--Huff theorem on increasing unions of sigma-fields
summary: A Lean formalization of the Broughton--Huff theorem that the ordinary union of a strictly increasing sequence of sigma-fields is not a sigma-field. The proof also proves the existence of a set measurable in the lattice supremum but in none of the individual sigma-fields.
